_about: Thomas M'Crie (1772-1835), the Scottish church historian: The Life of John Knox, in the new edition edited by his son Thomas M'Crie the younger (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1873), The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819, 2 vols, the first edition), and his histories of the Reformation in Italy and in Spain (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1842 reprints of the Edinburgh editions). Volume numbers read off the title pages. The surname check matches 'Crie' as a word, because the OCR prints the prefix as M', M‘ or Mc. Added 2026-10-03, two books by his son Thomas M'Crie the younger (1797-1875), which the name check finds just as well: the Sketches of Scottish Church History from the Reformation to the Revolution (6th ed., Edinburgh: Johnstone, 1849, two volumes bound as one; a Google scan, and Google asks non-commercial use, noted) and the Life of Thomas M'Crie, D.D. (Philadelphia, 1842). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing. Lectures on the Book of Esther (New York, 1838) and Works vol. 4 (Edinburgh, 1857) come from lane A's round-11 copy of this shelf, merged 2026-10-03.

mccrie-life-of-knox: The Life of John Knox, new edition edited by his son (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1873)

mccrie-life-of-melville-2: The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819), vol. 2
mccrie-reformation-italy: History of the Progress and Suppression of the Reformation in Italy in the Sixteenth Century (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1842)
mccrie-reformation-spain: History of the Progress and Suppression of the Reformation in Spain in the Sixteenth Century (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1842)
mccrie-sketches-scottish-church-history-: Sketches of Scottish Church History, by Thomas M'Crie the younger, 6th ed. (Edinburgh: Johnstone, 1849; Google scan)
mccrie-life-by-his-son-1842: The Life of Thomas M'Crie, D.D., by his son Thomas M'Crie (Philadelphia: William S. Young, 1842)
mccrie-esther-1838: Lectures on the Book of Esther (New York: Carter, 1838)
mccrie-works-4: The Works of Thomas M'Crie (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1857), vol. 4: Review of Tales of My Landlord; On the Unity of the Church; Sermons
